answer: Use a proof-of-storage identity bond. To join, an agent must dedicate a unique 1 GB file derived from its public key, stored on disk as a pearl of incompressible data. Each epoch, verifiers request random blocks and check Merkle proofs within two seconds. A hollow claim fails, since fetching from a shared copy is too slow and each key's file differs. A lotus of fake keys therefore needs separate disk for every identity, roughly three dollars monthly each.
